backupRestore.title: Backup and Restore
backupRestore.description: Keep settings and operational data in separate backup files. Restoring system data replaces current cases, users, orders, events, attachments, and counters.
backupRestore.wrongType: This backup belongs to a different restore option.

logLevel.title: System Log Level
logLevel.description: Controls how much detail the internal system log records, from errors only up to full request/debug detail. Takes effect immediately, no restart required.
logLevel.updateError: Could not update the log level

logSizes.title: Log Storage
logSizes.description: User activity and Shopfa transaction logs are kept indefinitely (the system log is automatically capped at 60 days / 50 MB -- see the Logs page).

dataSource.title: Order Data Source
dataSource.description: Until live Shopfa API access is available, order and customer data is read from orders imported below. Turn this on once Shopfa API credentials are configured on the server.
dataSource.notConfigured: The live API can't be enabled yet — SHOPFA_API_BASE_URL and SHOPFA_API_TOKEN are not configured on the server.
dataSource.updateError: Could not update the data source
dataSource.testConnectionHelp: Check whether the app can reach the shop right now, independent of the toggle above.
dataSource.testConnectionRequestFailed: Could not run the connection test

import.title: Import Orders
import.description: Upload an xlsx export of orders from Shopfa. Re-importing the same order updates it instead of creating a duplicate.
import.neverImported: No orders have been imported yet
